### [`old_editor_text`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_2f18.asm#L6) `$2F18-$2FFF`

*data*

Unused PETSCII text: WHTTWHHWWC, a count 20 19 ... 0, and three times a key list (CRSR, HOME, CLR, RVS, ENMXCTPSA, F1, LRD+-, F3, BQOZ, INST, DEL). It looks like the memory of an editor.
